content_sections.text: Head of Operations - Executive Education: Master's Degree, preferably in Business Administration or equivalent in any discipline from any recognized university. The candidate must have related experience in industry / academia. Post qualification experience at an Officer and above rank for at least 15 years with some of it in reputed Management Education Institute / University / College / Commercial organization of national / international repute. Preference shall be given to the candidate having at least 10 years' experience of any IIMs / prominent B-school.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Udaipur Head of Operations – Executive Education Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Head of Operations – Executive Education post is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIM Udaipur Head of Operations – Executive Education Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Head of Operations – Executive Education post at IIM Udaipur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIM Udaipur Head of Operations – Executive Education?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply Online for the Head of Operations – Executive Education position at IIM Udaipur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Head of Operations – Executive Education post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree, preferably in Business Administration or equivalent in any discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Head of Operations – Executive Education position at IIM Udaipur?
faq.answer: The salary for the Head of Operations – Executive Education post is Rs. 18 LPA Per Annum.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIM Udaipur Head of Operations – Executive Education Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Head of Operations – Executive Education post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by a Test/Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job location for the Head of Operations – Executive Education position?
faq.answer: The job location for this position is Udaipur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIM Udaipur recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Management Udaipur is https://www.iimu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Head of Operations – Executive Education post?
faq.answer: The Head of Operations – Executive Education position at IIM Udaipur is on a Contract basis.
